properties.notes: Full planning permission received.. Conversion of the Grade II listed building to 10 residential apartments at first and second floor and refurbishment of ground floor (former Post Office) A1 unit with change of use to include A1-A3 uses. Works to include partial demolition of rear storey structures and brick service flue, internal alterations and upgrades, with proposed new residential access stair to the rear courtyard to connect to the existing stairs at first floor level. Works to include partial demolition of rear single storey structures and brick service flue, internal alterations and upgrades, with proposed new residential access stair to the rear courtyard to connect to the existing stair at first floor level.
